toml:
# Multi-band jamming waterfall: low Earth orbit (LEO) positioning, navigation and timing
# (PNT) signals in four bands (UHF, L, S and C) beside GPS and Galileo, each band with
# its own jammer, drawn as one waterfall per band on one timeline.
#
# A LEO-PNT system that spreads its signals over several bands is harder to deny than a
# single L-band system: a jammer built for one band leaves the others alone. This
# scenario shows that with the `spectrum` kind's spectral separation coefficient (SSC)
# chain, band by band. Every signal is public or representative; none depends on a
# particular LEO system:
#   UHF  generic-uhf (465 MHz, BPSK(5) pilot and data, 10 MHz), -150 dBW   [representative]
#   L    xona-x5 (1190.51625 MHz, published), at its -144.9 dBW minimum; GPS L1 C/A and
#        Galileo E5a at their specification minimums
#   S    generic-s (2492.028 MHz, BPSK(5), 16.5 MHz), -150 dBW              [representative]
#   C    generic-c-band-leo (5020 MHz, BPSK(10), 20 MHz), -152 dBW          [representative]
# (BPSK binary phase-shift keying.) The LEO designs are drawn with every component,
# band-limited to their transmit bandwidth.
#
# Timeline (60 s, one row per second):
#   10 s  a continuous-wave (CW) tone at the UHF carrier, -120 dBW received.
#   20 s  a chirp (swept) jammer 16 MHz wide around L1, 9 microsecond sweeps, 50 mW at
#         100 m: it takes GPS L1 C/A and leaves the L5-band signals alone.
#   30 s  wideband (barrage) noise, 40 MHz around 1185 MHz, -118 dBW: it hits Galileo E5a
#         and Xona X5 together.
#   40 s  narrowband noise, 2 MHz at the S carrier, -128 dBW.
#   50 s  noise matched to the C-band signal's own spectrum, -124 dBW.
# The [grid] waterfall is the L band; three [[panels]] add UHF, S and C.
# MODELLED: the signal spectra are validated closed forms; every jammer, power and
# timing here is a scenario input.
kind = "spectrum"
seed = 11
duration_s = 60.0
step_s = 1.0

[receiver]
noise_figure_db = 2.0
antenna_temp_k = 290.0
tracking_threshold_dbhz = 25.0

[grid]
f_min_mhz = 1160.0
f_max_mhz = 1600.0
n_freq = 440

[[panels]]
name = "UHF"
f_min_mhz = 455.0
f_max_mhz = 475.0
n_freq = 200

[[panels]]
name = "S band"
f_min_mhz = 2482.0
f_max_mhz = 2502.0
n_freq = 200

[[panels]]
name = "C band"
f_min_mhz = 5005.0
f_max_mhz = 5035.0
n_freq = 200

[[bands]]
name = "generic-uhf"
signal = "generic-uhf"
signal_power_dbw = -150.0

[[bands]]
name = "gps-l1ca"

[[bands]]
name = "galileo-e5a"

[[bands]]
name = "xona-x5"
signal = "xona-x5"

[[bands]]
name = "generic-s"
signal = "generic-s"
signal_power_dbw = -150.0

[[bands]]
name = "generic-c-band-leo"
signal = "generic-c-band-leo"
signal_power_dbw = -152.0

[[jammers]]
name = "UHF CW tone"
waveform = "cw"
centre_mhz = 465.0
received_power_dbw = -120.0
on_s = 10.0

[[jammers]]
name = "L1 chirp privacy device"
waveform = "chirp"
centre_mhz = 1575.42
bandwidth_mhz = 16.0
sweep_period_us = 9.0
eirp_dbw = -13.0
range_m = 100.0
on_s = 20.0

[[jammers]]
name = "L5-band barrage"
waveform = "wideband"
centre_mhz = 1185.0
bandwidth_mhz = 40.0
received_power_dbw = -118.0
on_s = 30.0

[[jammers]]
name = "S narrowband noise"
waveform = "narrowband"
centre_mhz = 2492.028
bandwidth_mhz = 2.0
received_power_dbw = -128.0
on_s = 40.0

[[jammers]]
name = "C matched noise"
waveform = "matched"
centre_mhz = 5020.0
matched_to = "generic-c-band-leo"
received_power_dbw = -124.0
on_s = 50.0
